verdict.rationale: The evidence describes human-facing portals: eServices and EAMS accessed through SecureAccess Washington login, plus paper, email, mail or fax forms. Nothing documents a system-to-system channel such as system accounts, transmitter or bulk-file programs, batch providers or an API, or a published enrollment path for one. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, and the transactional host sits behind an authenticated login wall. Third-party firms using eServices is portal delegation, not a machine channel.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
